Now we need EU member countries that do not share a land border with Russia.

Which EU members border Russia? EU member states that are clear beyond Russia: Russia not an EU member. But among EU member states, which border Russia? Finland borders Russia (yes). Lithuania borders Russia (Kaliningrad). Latvia borders Russia (Kaliningrad). Estonia borders Russia. Also, Poland? Poland doesn't border Russia but borders Kaliningrad as well (land border). Actually Kaliningrad is an exclave of Russia between Poland and Lithuania. So Poland has border with Russia. Belarus is outside EU, but Poland borders Belarus but not Russia. However Poland has a border directly with Russia (Kaliningrad). Yes.

Also, Kazakhstan? Not EU. So only EU states that border Russia: Finland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland. Also Belarus is not EU.

Also Russia/Ukraine border? Ukraine is not EU. So only those.

Thus we need EU member countries with no land border with Russia: all EU members except Finland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland.
